data.did_you_know: Cleveland’s University Circle neighborhood, which encompasses around 550 acres, contains numerous institutions and businesses that employ 30,000 people.
data.description: Cleveland artist Garie Waltzer was commissioned to photograph University Circle for the Gund Foundation Annual Report in 2007. Her densely toned black-and-white photographs, many shot from elevated vantage points and employing deep vistas, reveal the Circle’s underlying structure: a graceful interweaving of nature and architecture united by elegantly drawn circulation patterns to produce a harmonious convergence of place and populace.
